content.json:
# Claude usage — gateway view

Usage for every Claude client routed through API Management: **Claude Code**, **Claude Desktop**, and anything else calling `/anthropic`. Sourced from `ApiManagementGatewayLlmLog` joined to `ApiManagementGatewayLogs`.

Attribution requires the gateway policy to stamp `x-caller-oid` and `x-caller-upn`, and the API diagnostic to log them. Without both, every row reads `anonymous`.

**Cost coverage:** these tiles exclude cache reads and writes. The Event Hub budget counter includes reads, so the displayed budget percentage is not the enforcement counter. Missing cache writes remain a material gap. Inference logs exclude empty `RequestId` probes; rejected requests remain in health counts. `IsStreamCompletion` is an unreliable diagnostic flag.

let rates = PRICING_CL
    | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by Model
    | project Model, InPer1K = InputTokensPrice, OutPer1K = OutputTokensPrice;
let gwBase = ApiManagementGatewayLogs
    | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
    | where Url has "/anthropic"
    | extend OidReq  = tostring(BackendRequestHeaders["x-caller-oid"]),
             OidResp = tostring(ResponseHeaders["x-caller-oid"]),
             RawUpn  = tostring(BackendRequestHeaders["x-caller-upn"]),
             TierReq = tostring(BackendRequestHeaders["x-caller-tier"]),
             TierResp= tostring(ResponseHeaders["x-caller-tier"]),
             DeniedBy= tostring(ResponseHeaders["x-claude-denied-by"]),
             UA      = tostring(RequestHeaders["User-Agent"])
    | extend Oid = iff(isempty(OidReq), OidResp, OidReq)
    | extend Tier = iff(isnotempty(TierReq), TierReq, iff(isnotempty(TierResp), TierResp, "unknown"))
    | extend Client = case(UA has "claude-cli", "Claude Code",
                           UA has "Electron" and UA has "Claude/", "Claude Desktop",
                           UA startswith "Bun/", "Claude Desktop",
                           isempty(UA), "Unknown",
                           "Other");
let ids = gwBase | where isnotempty(RawUpn) | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, RawUpn) by Oid | project Oid, KnownUpn = RawUpn;
let gw = gwBase
    | join kind=leftouter ids on Oid
    | extend User = case(isnotempty(RawUpn), RawUpn, isnotempty(KnownUpn), KnownUpn, isnotempty(Oid), Oid, "anonymous")
    | project CorrelationId, TimeGenerated, ResponseCode, Method, Url, BackendTime, TotalTime, User, Oid, Client, UA, Tier, DeniedBy;
let llm = ApiManagementGatewayLlmLog
    | where isnotempty(RequestId)
    | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
    | extend Model = iff(isempty(ModelName), "", replace_regex(ModelName, @"-\d{8}$", ""));
let usage = gw
    | join kind=leftouter (llm) on CorrelationId
    | where isnotempty(RequestId) or ResponseCode >= 400
    | extend IsInference = isnotempty(RequestId)
    | lookup kind=leftouter rates on Model
    | extend EstCost = (PromptTokens * coalesce(InPer1K, 0.0)
                     + CompletionTokens * coalesce(OutPer1K, 0.0)) / 1000.0;
gw | summarize by Client | order by Client asc
